Reads three float components at offsets 13560, 13564 and 13568 (0x34F8, 0x34FC, 0x3500, interpreted as velocity components), squares and sums them, takes the square root, multiplies by the conversion constant 2.2369363 (flt_59F128, interpreted as the m/s-to-mph factor), and returns the result truncated to int. Sibling of SpeedMagnitude; selected by the calling formatter based on an encoding flag. Called by GlobalStateBranchFormat (0x0049D3F0) and UILayoutDispatchWithDataPrep (0x004DB550).

operations.description: Read three float components at dword_7C54E0 offsets 13560, 13564 and 13568, square each and sum the squares.
Take the square root of the summed squares to obtain the vector magnitude.
Multiply the magnitude by the 2.2369363 conversion constant held in flt_59F128.
Return the magnitude cast to int. Consumed by GlobalStateBranchFormat (0x0049D3F0) and UILayoutDispatchWithDataPrep (0x004DB550).
